usedFor: Square sales events, such as “New Order”, start another workflow through “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities.

bestTemplate.name: “New Order” in Square, then “Flow in Flow” in viaSocket utilities
bestTemplate.why: A new order launches a second workflow from the current one, so order handling can live in its own flow.

watchOut: “Flow in Flow” requires a flowid, the child flow script id in the same project, so build the child first.
